caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, also known as a highboy, rendered in shades of brown. The chest is comprised of two main vertical sections: the upper section has four small drawers arranged in a horizontal row at the top, with the central drawer featuring a carved sunburst motif. Below this row are three larger, progressively wider drawers. The lower section, supported by four turned legs, contains three drawers with one central drawer flanked by two slightly larger drawers. The legs are straight in the back and rounded with carved details in the front. The hardware on the drawers consists of symmetrical, decorative metal handles. The overall form of the chest is rectangular with a slightly protruding top and simple molding along the top edge, with all elements set against a plain, light background.
title: Highboy
